## Question

`standalone-aff` is four tasks, all subagent, one sitting, no human stops. Wave 1 moves the store client into orchestra. Wave 2 rewrites the skill commands and strips this repo, in parallel. Wave 3 runs the exit checks through `bin/aff` and `bin/orchestra`.

Approve the plan, change the tasks, or send the phase back to discuss?

## Answer

Approved. The four tasks stand. `execute-phase` may run.
